name: registry
description: Read one workflow agent's registration and every runtime instance it reports, plus service health. The Centre Agent needs this to answer 'is the agent I am about to notify actually online'.
notes: get_agent_registration is opened to caller_type=project_owner or a service token with service_role=centre. The Centre Agent's token must therefore carry service_role=centre; a researcher token gets denied.

There is no register_* on this card: the Centre Agent does not create agents. Its own registration is made by the Project Owner with kind=centre, because register_workflow_agent(kind=centre) requires project_owner.
An unknown agent is not an unavailable agent. get_agent_registration answering agent_not_found means the mapping names something that was never registered; a transport failure means nothing at all.

tools.name: get_agent_registration
tools.description: Read one workflow agent registration and its runtime instances.
allowed: telling an owner their mapping points at an offline agent instead of a broken queue

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return authenticated Registry service and storage health.
allowed: deciding whether a delivery failure is the registry
